buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Refrigerated Heavy Duty Stackable Incubator Shaker with two stacking 1. System should be Heavy duty refrigerated incubator shaker preferably with glide up/ glide down door. 2. The system should be supplied with dual unit stackable refrigerated shaker incubator on e above the other with stacking kit. 3. System design must support future expansion to 3 units. o o 4. System should have Temperature range: 20 C below ambient to + 60 C accuracy: ± 0. o o 15 C at 37 C or lesser inside the flask. 5. System should have LCD display, clearly shows operating parameters and actual value. Displayed parameters can be selected by user. and quickly. 6. System should have minimum 10-15 steps programming steps for parameter changes to temperature, speed and other parameter on a timed basis. 7. System Should have triple-eccentric counter balanced drive with 7 to 9 ball bearing / Mag netic drive driven by solid state brushless DC motor. 8. System should have Hermetically sealed compressor uses CFC-free refrigerant 9. The RPM range is 25 to 400 rpm with 1 inch orbit 10. System should indicate when speed deviates more than 5 rpm or temperature more than

1°C from setpoint, and when program or time has finished. Alarm may be muted 11. System should be fitted with mechanical and electronic safety devices Sensors limit speed when shaker is unbalanced, stops shaker when excess vibration is detected or door opene d, and shuts off temperature when high-temp. limit is exceeded o o 12. The operating ambient temperature condition should be 10 C to + 35 C. 13. System should have Timer; 0.1 to 99.9 hours and continuous operation option. 14. System should have setpoints and operating status retained by non-volatile memory and s hould automatic restart after power is restored 15. System should have minimum capable of holding flasks: - 90 no. of 50 ml, 38 no. of 100/12 5 ml, 30 no. of 250 ml, 24 no. of 500 ml, 14 no. of 1 L, 8 no. of 2 L, 6 no. of 2.8/3 L, 16. The Size of shaking platform: at least (30”x18”).±1” 17. System should have slide out platform for easy access to all the samples on run. 18. The following clamps and Platform to be supplied along with the Shaker with each unit - a. Aluminium Universal Platform minimum 30 x 18 inch ±1 inch. b. Total 10 Nos. of Stainless-steel clamps for 250 ml Erlenmeyer flask c. Total 10 Nos. of Stainless-steel clamps for 500 ml Erlenmeyer flask. d. Total 04 Nos. of Stainless-steel clamps for 1000 ml Erlenmeyer flask. e. Total 02 Nos. of Stainless-steel clamps for 2000 ml Erlenmeyer flask. f. Total 02 Nos. of Stainless-steel clamps for 2.8L/ 3L Erlenmeyer flask. 19. The system should be supplied with all the above required Platform and clamps. System c an accommodate Dedicated Platform 250 ml, 500 ml ,1 litre and 2 litre Erlenmeyer clamps f or higher throughput with dedicated vessels/ Flasks. 20. System should be supplied with stacking kit for 3 units one above the other along with the instrument. 21. External Dimensions should be 136 × 85 × 68 cm (W × D × H) or lesser. 22. The system should be European CE/ US FDA/ CE andI SO Certified. 23. The operating Voltage is 230V, 50 HZ. 24. Committee asked for Demonstration (Physical/ Online) of quoted Model then Demo will be provided by the firm at own cost before opening of Technical/financial bid, if require. 25. The system should be installed by the trained Engineer and users training should be given on Application, operation and maintenance 26. The system should be supplied with all accessories/ power chords required to function. 27. The system should be quoted with suitable servo voltage stabilisers. 28. All specifications of the system should be tested and guaranteed. The specification should not be typical or relative values. 29. Warranty: 5 Years OEM warranty. Also the bidders are requested to submit thei

r quote (rates) for subsequent 05 years comprehensive AMC (including all spares , accessories and labour) failure to comply with this condition will entail the rejec tion of the bids. The price comparison shall be made considering the basic price and post warranty CMC. 30. A satisfactory performance certificate should be submitted from minimum 10 users where the quoted model has been installed. 31. Regular calibration, including preventive maintenance, all-inclusive labour, and required c onsumables/ kits, is to be provided by the vendor during the warranty period. 32. Installation of the instrument and accessories should be done free of cost; vendor has to m ake own arrangements for manpower/ labour/ trolleys/ Forklifts arrangement involved for s hifting, carrying and lifting of instruments to carry out installation proceedings in lab. Institu te will not provide any kind labour support. 33. There must be after sales service support available in the Delhi-NCR. 34. Compliance to each of the above points should be separately indicated and evidence pres ence for each of them (Product brochures should be highlighted wherever required). Certifi cate of calibration and inspection from factory to be supplied with system. 35. Original company literature with offered specifications should be enclosed with the bid faili ng which the bid may be treated non-responsive. 36. Only Standard Models should be quoted, and custom-made products will not be considere d. product must be available on official website of supplier. Credibility: The vendor should demonstrate a record of successful installations of at least 50 installations of quoted models in Govt. institutions/research centres across India. A com prehensive list of prior installations should be provided. Scope of Supply Supply, installation, training and final acceptance tests at RCB Faridabad Training Training to be provided to the researchers on site after installation of the equipment. PRE BID MEETING: 27.10.2027 @ 11:00AM at Regional Centre For Biote chnology, Faridabad. Technical Evaluation strictly be done on the basis of Buyer added Terms and conditions The payment shall be made via Direct Bank Transfer or 100% LC after successful installation a nd commissioning of the equipment subject to submission of the BG and confirmation of the s ame. Other Commercial Terms: a) The local custom & consignment clearance will be carried out directly by RCB through its authorised clearing agent. b) Tenders will be evaluated on the basis of buyer specific added terms & conditions arlead y incorporated in the tender document. No new condition will be brought in while scrutinizi ng and evaluating the tenders. Where the offers received in different currencies, the price c onversion will be made taking into account the exchange rate of SBI B.C. selling rate ruling

at the time of price bid opening. Conditional tenders will not be considered. c) IN CASE OF IMPORT THE TENDERERS ARE REQUIRED TO QUOTE FOB & CIF VALU E SEPARATELY DULY MENTIONING THE BREAK-UP DETAILS FOR FREIGHT & INSUR ANCE. THIS CONDITION SHOULD BE STRICTLY ADHERED TO, FAILING WHICH THEI R OFFER WILL BE SUMMARILY REJECTED. The comparison between the indigenous and the foreign offers shall be made on FOR desti nation basis and CIF/CIP basis respectively. However, the CIF/CIP prices quoted by any forei gn bidder shall be loaded further as under: i) Towards customs duty and other statutory levies –as per applicable rates with CDEC. ii) Towards custom clearance, inland transportation etc. - 0.5% of the CIF/CIP value. NOTE: For any clarifications with regards to the bid, prospective bidders may kin dly mail their queries to purchase@rcb.res.in Contact number: 0129-2848813/941 . 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file. 4. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Payment online through RTGS / internet banking in Beneficiary name EXECUTIVE DIRECTOR Account No. 349301000051 IFSC Code ICIC0003493 Bank Name ICICI BANK LTD. Branch address NCR BIOTECH SCIENCE CLUSTER, FARIDABAD . Bidder to indicate bid number and name of bidding entity in the transaction details field at the time of on- line transfer. Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the Online Payment Transfer along with bid.
